tracks.title: Machine Learning → Deep Learning
tracks.tagline: From a straight line to a language model
tracks.summary: Every model derived from first principles: a film for intuition, the full math, and code you write yourself, from linear regression to how large language models are built.

sections.title: Classical machine learning
sections.summary: The core models and how to judge them honestly.

sections.title: Deep learning
sections.summary: Neural networks for images and text.

sections.title: How LLMs are built
sections.summary: Attention, transformers, and training a language model.

tracks.title: AI Engineering: Building Agents
tracks.tagline: From one API call to a production agent
tracks.summary: How to build real products on top of large language models: prompts, tools, retrieval, agents, evaluation, security and shipping. Every lab runs a simulated model in your browser, so no API key is needed.

sections.label: B
sections.title: Working with LLMs
sections.summary: Call a model, control its output, give it tools and your own documents.

sections.label: I
sections.title: Building agents
sections.summary: Agent loops, tool design, workflows, memory, retrieval, evaluation and multi-agent systems.

sections.label: P
sections.title: Production-grade agents
sections.summary: Reliability, security, observability, cost, evals in production, long-running agents and shipping.

lessons.title: The Math Toolkit
lessons.summary: Everything the course leans on: vectors, distance, the dot product, matrices, derivatives, logarithms and probability.

film.title: The Toolkit
film.note: 2 min 18 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: The maths behind the course: vectors, distance, the dot product, matrices, derivatives and probability.

lessons.title: Linear Regression
lessons.summary: How a straight line learns to fit noisy data: errors, squared loss, gradients and gradient descent.

film.title: The Line That Learned
film.note: 2 min 12 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: Linear regression, squared error, the loss valley, learning rates and gradient descent. Best with sound on.

lessons.title: Logistic Regression
lessons.summary: Predicting yes or no: the sigmoid squash, log loss, each point's pull, and the border between two classes.

film.title: How Sure to Be
film.note: 2 min 22 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: Logistic regression: the sigmoid, log loss, each point's pull on the curve, and the decision boundary in two dimensions.

lessons.title: Support Vector Machines
lessons.summary: Finding the safest border: margins, the widest street, support vectors and the hinge loss.

film.title: The Widest Street
film.note: 2 min 22 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: Support vector machines: many borders, the widest street, support vectors, margins, the hinge cost and the soft margin.

lessons.title: K-Nearest Neighbors
lessons.summary: Classify a point by asking its neighbours: distance, the vote, choosing k, and why measurements need the same scale.

film.title: Ask the Neighbours
film.note: 2 min 10 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: K-nearest neighbours: distance, the vote, how k shapes the border, and rescaling.

lessons.title: Naive Bayes
lessons.summary: A spam filter from word counts: priors, likelihoods, Bayes' rule, the naive assumption and add-one smoothing.

film.title: Counting Words
film.note: 2 min 10 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: Naive Bayes: a spam filter from word counts, Bayes' rule, and the zero problem.

lessons.title: Decision Trees
lessons.summary: Twenty questions for data: Gini impurity, finding the best split, growing a tree, and stopping before it memorises noise.

film.title: Twenty Questions
film.note: 2 min 12 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: Decision trees: Gini impurity, the best split, growing the tree and overfitting.

lessons.title: Random Forests and Gradient Boosting
lessons.summary: Many trees are wiser than one: bootstrap samples, voting forests, and boosting trees that learn from each other's mistakes.

film.title: Many Small Voices
film.note: 2 min 20 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: Random forests and gradient boosting: bootstrap samples, voting, and trees that learn from each other's mistakes.

lessons.title: Evaluating Models
lessons.summary: Scoring a model honestly: train and test sets, cross-validation, the confusion matrix, precision and recall, ROC curves, and bias versus variance.

film.title: Honest Scores
film.note: 2 min 10 s, best with sound and narration on
film.blurb: Evaluating models: held-out data, cross-validation, the confusion matrix, precision and recall, ROC curves, and bias versus variance.

lessons.title: K-Means Clustering
lessons.summary: Finding groups with no labels at all: centres, assignments, the update loop, and choosing how many groups.

lessons.title: Principal Component Analysis
lessons.summary: Squeezing many measurements into a few: variance, directions of spread, and projecting the data onto them.

lessons.title: Project: An Honest Diagnosis Model
lessons.summary: An end-to-end project on real medical measurements: explore, scale, compare the models you wrote, tune with cross-validation, choose a threshold for recall, and report one honest test score.

lessons.title: Neural Networks and Backpropagation
lessons.summary: Layers of tiny logistic regressions, and the chain rule that trains all of them at once.

lessons.summary: Initialisation, momentum and Adam, batch norm, dropout, and reading a training curve.

lessons.title: Convolutional Networks
lessons.summary: How filters slide over images to find edges, textures and objects.

lessons.title: Sequence Models
lessons.summary: Reading in order: recurrent networks, memory, and why long sequences are hard.

lessons.title: Word Embeddings
lessons.summary: Turning words into vectors whose distances carry meaning.

lessons.title: Project: An Image Classifier from Scratch
lessons.summary: Build, train and debug a small neural network for images, then compare it with a convolutional one.

lessons.title: Attention and Transformers
lessons.summary: Every word looks at every other word: queries, keys, values, and the transformer block.

lessons.title: Tokenization
lessons.summary: How text becomes numbers: characters, words, and byte-pair encoding.

lessons.title: Pretraining a Language Model
lessons.summary: Next-token prediction at scale: the loss, the data, and what scaling buys.

lessons.title: Fine-Tuning and Alignment
lessons.summary: From a text predictor to an assistant: instruction tuning, preference learning and RLHF.

lessons.title: Project: A Tiny GPT
lessons.summary: Write and train a small transformer that generates text, one component at a time.

lessons.title: How an LLM Behaves
lessons.summary: Tokens, next-token sampling, temperature, context windows, and why the same prompt can give different answers.

lessons.title: The Messages API
lessons.summary: Calling Claude from code: roles, system prompts, multi-turn conversations, streaming, tokens and cost.

lessons.title: Prompt Engineering
lessons.summary: Clear instructions, examples, XML structure, step-by-step reasoning, and testing prompts instead of guessing.

lessons.title: Structured Output
lessons.summary: Getting reliable JSON: schemas, validation, repair loops, and what to do when the model gets it wrong.

lessons.title: Tool Use
lessons.summary: Letting the model call your functions: tool schemas, the tool-use round trip, and handling tool errors.

lessons.title: Embeddings and Semantic Search
lessons.summary: Meaning as vectors: embedding text, cosine similarity, chunking documents and searching them.

lessons.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
lessons.summary: Answering from your own documents: retrieve, ground, cite, and say "I don't know" when the answer is not there.

lessons.title: Project: A Grounded Support Assistant
lessons.summary: A help-desk assistant that answers only from a product handbook, cites its sources, returns structured tickets, and passes a test set.

lessons.title: The Agent Loop
lessons.summary: From one tool call to an agent: the loop, stopping conditions, step limits, and parallel tool calls.

lessons.title: Designing Tools
lessons.summary: Tools a model can use well: names, descriptions, inputs, useful errors, and keeping the toolset small.

lessons.title: Workflow Patterns
lessons.summary: Chaining, routing, parallel calls, orchestrator and workers, evaluator and optimiser: when a workflow beats an agent.

lessons.title: Context Engineering and Memory
lessons.summary: What goes into the context window: summaries, trimming, scratchpads, and long-term memory.

lessons.title: Advanced Retrieval
lessons.summary: Hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, and retrieval as a tool the agent chooses to use.

lessons.title: Evaluating LLM Apps
lessons.summary: Test sets, graders, LLM-as-judge, and measuring an agent instead of eyeballing it.

lessons.title: Multi-Agent Systems and MCP
lessons.summary: Subagents, handoffs and shared tools through the Model Context Protocol.

lessons.title: Project: A Research Agent
lessons.summary: An agent that plans, searches, reads and writes a cited report, with an evaluation suite that scores every version.

lessons.title: Reliability Engineering

lessons.title: Cost and Latency

lessons.title: Evals in Production
lessons.summary: Regression suites, online checks, feedback loops, and shipping prompt changes safely.

lessons.title: Long-Running and Stateful Agents
lessons.summary: Checkpoints, resumable runs, queues, and agents that work for hours.

lessons.title: Shipping Agents
lessons.summary: Putting it all together: an API service, configuration, rate limits, deployment and a launch checklist.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Production Support Agent
lessons.summary: A customer-support agent built to production standard: tools with guardrails, retries, traces, cost limits and an eval suite, scored against a readiness checklist.
